verdict.rationale: GlitchTip does not ship its own SDKs. Its documented approach is to accept data from Sentry's open-source client SDKs, with general SDK setup instructions, and community users confirm the Sentry reporter ecosystem (including Svelte) works reliably with it. Coverage across frontend, backend and mobile is only implied (JavaScript source maps, native dSYM/PDB symbol uploads), and one user reports ad-blockers suppressing browser error reporting. Missing for 10: first-party GlitchTip-branded SDKs, explicit documentation of automatic uncaught-error capture, explicit per-platform coverage of web, backend and mobile SDKs, and a mitigation for frontend ad-blocker blocking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my web frontend, backend services, and mobile apps with official SDKs that capture uncaught errors automatically

citations.quote: GlitchTip can use Sentry's open source SDKs to receive error data from your application.
See our general SDK setup instructions for getting started with any Sentry-compatible SDK.
Our app is compatible with Sentry client SDKs, but easier to run.
Your web app can send any errors it encounters to GlitchTip, which will notify you and record the error as an issue so you can see the details.
